interpretation: Re-rendered logged Snapshot histories, not sealed original-pixel or original-source replay

cases.limitation: Only H1 was historically executed for this request. New H2-H4 repeat the target and extend it.
This is a contrasting shape rejection with a valid original pusher gate, not another claimed double-pusher failure.

paired_design: Each case uses one fixed full four-frame/three-action history for both frozen/adapted H4. Only predictions feed AR. Truth is executed once per case, after both roles predict.
outputs_required: Every raw H1-H4, per-frame pusher/state/shape/coverage gates with original invalid reasons, full real before/after/contact prefix, input/action/RNG hashes, model identities and reserved/returned counts. Never promote a candidate pose or fill an invalid measurement from truth.
setup_caveat: make_environment('L') twice costs2reset/2settle and no warmup controls; four histories are restored/rendered. Default ManualSession first resets T, so two sessions plus L resets would instead cost4resets and12warmup controls. Root must freeze the actual initializer and count all calls.
